Steps to run the GUI client (macOS, Apple Silicon):

1. Put these two files on your Mac (e.g., Desktop): gui_app-macos.zip and crypto_client_run.txt.
2. Open Terminal and run:
   cd ~/Desktop
   unzip -o gui_app-macos.zip
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine gui_app.app
   export E2E_WS_BASE=tcp://10.2.52.219:5088
   open gui_app.app

3. In the window that appears, enter your username and a passphrase (this creates your keys). Click Connect.
4. Make sure you are on the same network as the server and keep Terminal open while the app is running.

View your local database (contacts, sessions, messages)
- Ask for the file: dump_client_db (binary) and place it next to crypto_client_run.txt (e.g., Desktop).
- In Terminal:
    cd ~/Desktop
    chmod +x dump_client_db
    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine dump_client_db
    ./dump_client_db
  It will prompt for your username (or use --db to point at a specific ~/.e2e/<user>/client.db) and passphrase if you choose decrypted view.
